_comment: COUPLING tier-2, VECTOR, a MEASURED LIMITATION rather than a capability. The vector pair fixtures verify the exchange on a patch test, where the exact stress is constant, every recovery is exact and the two sides' tractions cancel to 1e-9 — a real verification of the mechanism and also the friendliest possible case for the traction channel. This measures the case they do not cover, on the same participants and geometry, driven by boundary data that is NOT a solution of the Navier equations so that the answer is genuinely two-dimensional. Splitting the domain gives the Neumann subproblem two corners where its traction-loaded interface meets a displacement-prescribed y-face, and a Dirichlet-Neumann corner in elasticity carries a stress singularity that the monolithic problem — whose interface is interior — does not have. Result, over a 4x refinement with the Neumann side handed the monolithic interface traction directly so that no iteration is in the way: the displacement converges (1.22e-02 -> 2.34e-03) while the exported traction at the interface end gets WORSE (2.11x -> 2.51x the true value), which no discretisation error does. Consequence, stated rather than tuned away: on a vector interface that meets a constrained boundary, the DISPLACEMENT channel of a partitioned Dirichlet-Neumann coupling is trustworthy and the exported-TRACTION channel is not trustworthy near the interface ends. This is why vector_arrangement asserts traction equilibrium on the interface interior and why the pair fixtures' traction claims rest on the patch test.

_mutation.note: T2_MUTATE=1 swaps the boundary data for the patch-test field, whose exact stress is constant. The Dirichlet-Neumann corner then carries no singularity, the recovery becomes exact at every resolution (t_peak 1.0000 at 13x11, 26x22 and 52x44; t_rel 1.1e-13), and the growth this fixture asserts disappears — the run fails on traction_peak_did_not_grow. That is the control: the effect is a property of the DATA at the corner, so a fixture that reported it either way would be measuring nothing. It also independently re-establishes that the recovery itself is exact where the stress is smooth, which is what the pair fixtures rely on.
